articles.summary: Starbucks Corporation (NASDAQ: SBUX) today announced that Brian Niccol, chairman and chief executive officer, and Cathy Smith, evp, chief financial officer, will host a fireside chat at the Bernstein 42 nd Annual Strategic Decisions Conference on Thursday, May 28 th , 2026, at 11:00 a.m. Eastern Time. The fireside chat will be webcast live from the company’s Investor Relations website at https://investor.starbucks.com on the Events Presentations page. About Starbucks Since 1971, Starbucks Coffee Company has been committed to responsibly sourcing and roasting high-quality arabica coffee. Today, with a global footprint of more than 41,000 company-operated and licensed coffeehouses and a growing presence in consumer-packaged goods, we are the world's premier purveyor of specialty coffee.
